title: 1. Ground Rules: Mystical vs. Mechanical
use_cases: Use when defining the boundary between mystical and mechanical systems
Implement when establishing governance for magical technology interactions
Configure when designing shared resources across magical and technical domains
content:
Magic embodies wonder, ancient knowledge, and forces beyond reason. Technology represents research, progress, and often control. Decide up front:

1. Who polices (or abuses) the boundary?
2. Where do they overlap?
3. What can each system do that the other cannot?

These sorts of questions can help you get a clearer view on your world’s systems.
